differentiator.orbit_description: 3U CubeSat at 550 km circular, Bc=180.0 kg/m^2
differentiator.swing_sentence: At 550 km with Bc=180 kg/m^2: solar min lifetime 15.0 yr (VIOLATED), solar max lifetime 2.57 yr (OK). Same orbit. Opposite verdict. The solar cycle decides.

surya.notes: ESTIMATED. Activity index is mean top-1% AIA 94A pixel intensity from one forward pass on Oct 2014 benchmark data, normalized to ~Oct 2014 reference level. This is a scalar proxy for near-term flare-associated EUV activity, not a calibrated X-ray flux value. Source: Roy et al. 2025 Surya-1.0, NASA SDO bench, AIA 94A channel. REPORTED ALONGSIDE the NOAA predicted-flux envelope for context; no code applies this index to the envelope or to the deorbit compliance verdict, which computes from the frozen NRLMSISE-00 decay table.

beneficiary_sizing.missions_per_year_quote: now it is not unusual for 40 university-class missions to fly every year
beneficiary_sizing.missions_per_year_source: Swartwout and Jayne, 'University-Class Spacecraft by the Numbers: Success, Failure, Debris. (But Mostly Success.)', 30th AIAA/USU Conference on Small Satellites, 2016, https://digitalcommons.usu.edu/smallsat/2016/TS13Education/1
beneficiary_sizing.university_failure_rate_quote: about 40% of all manifested university-class missions fail to achieve any of their primary mission objectives
beneficiary_sizing.university_failure_rate_source: Swartwout and Jayne, SmallSat 2016, https://digitalcommons.usu.edu/smallsat/2016/TS13Education/1 (figure dates to 2016)
beneficiary_sizing.licensing_runway_source: NASA CubeSat 101 (CSLI, 2017), Section 2.8 'Regulatory Licensing (4-6 months)'; same document: FCC requires a minimum of 90 days from application receipt, and IARU coordination starts immediately at manifest. Age flagged per D5.
